faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions we receive
faq.q1: How can I book an appointment?
faq.a1: You can contact us by phone at +30 2310 545 261, by email at iopapaio@gmail.com, or by filling out the contact form on the website. We will respond within 24 hours to schedule a meeting.
faq.q2: What areas of law do you specialize in?
faq.a2: Our primary specialisations are Banking Law & Objections and the Out-of-Court Debt Settlement Mechanism. We also handle Criminal, Commercial, Real Estate, Administrative, Inheritance, Tax and Labor Law matters. You can see all areas in detail on the «Practice Areas» page.
faq.q3: Do you handle cases outside Thessaloniki?
faq.a3: Yes, we handle cases throughout Greece. For cases outside Thessaloniki, collaboration with a local lawyer or additional travel expenses may be required, agreed upon in advance.
faq.q4: How long does it take to resolve a case?
faq.a4: The duration depends on the type of case, jurisdiction and court schedules. At our first meeting we will provide a realistic time estimate based on our experience with similar cases.
faq.q5: Is the information I share confidential?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We are bound by professional confidentiality as provided by the Greek Code of Lawyers. Any information you share with us — whether in meetings, by email or by phone — remains strictly confidential.
faq.q6: Can I contact you by email for updates?
faq.a6: Of course. We provide continuous updates on the progress of your case via email, phone or in-person meetings, according to your preferences.

banking.title: Banking Law & Objections
banking.desc: Objections, enforcement, suspension of auctions and defence of borrowers.
banking.longDesc: Banking Law is the firm's primary area of expertise. We handle a wide range of cases concerning the borrower–bank relationship, with a focus on timely and effective defence against claims by banking institutions and loan management companies (funds). Our experience covers objections to payment orders, enforcement objections, suspension and annulment of auctions, as well as offensive claims against banks for abusive terms.
banking.approach: We do not accept a payment order, seizure or auction as a fait accompli. We open the file from the start and check who is demanding, how much they are demanding, with what documents they prove it and whether they have met the lawful conditions. Our goal is to shift the balance of power before the debtor is driven into a settlement out of fear, or into the loss of property without any genuine legal scrutiny.
services: Objections against payment orders
Objections against writs, seizures and acts of compulsory enforcement
Applications for stay of auction, where there are lawful and documented grounds
Review and challenge of claims by funds, claims-acquisition companies and debt management companies
Review of claim assignment, standing, interest, charges and the actual amount of the debt
Negotiation of settlements with banks, doValue, Intrum, Cepal and other management companies
Lawsuits and legal actions for abusive terms, opaque charges and inadequate notification
Measures to protect the primary residence or business premises, where the applicable legal framework allows

extrajudicial.title: Out-of-Court Mechanism & Negotiations
extrajudicial.desc: Out-of-Court Debt Settlement Mechanism (Law 4738/2020), bilateral negotiations and debt restructuring.
extrajudicial.longDesc: We do not negotiate blindly. First we check the debt, then we build the solution. We handle applications to the Out-of-Court Mechanism of Law 4738/2020 and direct negotiations with banks, the State, insurance funds, claims-acquisition companies (funds) and debt management companies (servicers). We examine the amount, the interest, the charges, the creditor's standing and the debtor's real capacity.
extrajudicial.approach: Our goal is a settlement that is not signed out of fear, but rests on scrutiny, negotiation and a clear strategy.
services: Application for the Out-of-Court Debt Settlement Mechanism (Law 4738/2020)
Negotiation of debt restructuring with banks, the State and insurance funds
Bilateral negotiations with banks and loan management companies
Bankruptcy application and reorganisation plan (New Insolvency Code)
Over-indebted household debt settlement
Strategy planning for repayment and asset protection

criminal.title: Criminal Law
criminal.desc: Defence in criminal cases at all levels, in collaboration with specialist attorneys.
criminal.longDesc: Criminal prosecution can dramatically alter someone's life. Proper defence from the very first moment — even before the apologia — is critical to the outcome of the case. The firm handles criminal cases in collaboration with experienced associate criminal lawyers, ensuring the best possible local and subject-matter representation.
criminal.approach: We meticulously study the case file, identify procedural gaps and build the defence strategy that best serves our client, in close collaboration with specialists in criminal law.
services: Defence of defendants at all stages of preliminary and main proceedings
Representation of victims as civil claimants
Appeals and cassation
Financial crimes and press offences
Cases against life, bodily integrity and property
Applications for suspension, conversion and postponement of sentence execution

commercial.title: Commercial Law
commercial.desc: Corporate transactions, contracts and commercial disputes.
commercial.longDesc: Businesses operate in a complex legal environment that requires constant attention. We provide comprehensive legal support to businesses of all sizes, from incorporation and organization to contract management and resolution of commercial disputes.
commercial.approach: We combine legal expertise with an understanding of business needs, so that the solutions we propose are not only legally sound but also practically applicable.

Legal due diligence in acquisitions and mergers

realEstate.desc: Property transactions, leases and land registry matters.
realEstate.longDesc: Buying or selling property is one of the most important financial decisions in a person's life. A thorough legal review of titles and proper drafting of contracts are essential to avoid future problems.
realEstate.approach: We perform a full title check at the land registry and cadastre, monitor the entire process through to registration and ensure that our client is fully protected.

Lease agreements (residential and commercial)
Tenant — landlord disputes, evictions

administrative.longDesc: The relationship of citizens and businesses with public administration is often complex. We provide legal support in cases involving challenges to administrative acts, licensing and state decisions, in collaboration with specialist administrative law attorneys.

about.title: Our Firm
about.name: Ioannis Papaioannou
about.bio1: With more than 25 years in banking law and enforcement proceedings, we defend borrowers, individuals and businesses against banks, funds and debt management companies. We do not accept an auction, a seizure or a payment order as a fait accompli — every file is examined from the start.
about.bio2: We approach every case with full commitment, combining in-depth knowledge of the law with a practical approach to problem solving.
about.edu1: Faculty of Law, Democritus University of Thrace, Komotini
about.edu2: LL.M. Postgraduate Studies, Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich
about.teaserSub: Specialists in foreclosures, objections and debt settlement — in Thessaloniki and throughout Greece.
about.value1Desc: Strict adherence to professional ethics in every case we handle.
about.value2Desc: Personal communication and immediate updates on every development.
about.value3Desc: Continuous professional training and close monitoring of case law.
bioParagraphs: Ioannis Papaioannou is an Attorney at the Supreme Court of Greece (Areios Pagos), with extensive courtroom experience in civil, commercial and banking law. He has maintained a law office in Thessaloniki since 2000, handling cases of significant legal and economic importance for individuals, professionals and businesses.

Born in Preveza and raised in Munich, he holds a law degree from the Democritus University of Thrace and an LL.M. from Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München. His legal career combines Greek courtroom practice with a German legal education — a combination that shapes his approach to complex cases: precise, methodical and strategically minded.

In recent years he has concentrated a significant part of his practice on banking law cases, enforcement proceedings, foreclosure auctions, objections against payment orders and disputes with funds and debt management companies. His practice is not limited to passive defence of the borrower, but includes a full review of the claim, its legitimacy, the enforcement acts, interest charges, fees and the chain of debt transfer.

Particular emphasis is placed on protecting the home and assets of debtors facing payment orders, seizures and foreclosure auctions. His approach combines judicial defence with substantive negotiation — aiming not merely at temporary relief from pressure, but at a genuine strategic solution.

He also heads the legal team of the Association of Borrowers and Consumer Protection of Northern Greece, actively supporting borrowers and consumers facing over-indebtedness, bank claims and enforcement proceedings. This role reflects his consistent engagement with debtor protection issues and his conviction that legal support against banks, funds and debt management companies must be immediate, well-documented and assertive.

His legal philosophy is built on careful study of each case file, timely use of procedural options and a realistic but determined approach. Every payment order, every seizure and every foreclosure auction is treated not as a fait accompli, but as an act that must be rigorously examined — legally and factually.

The office's goal is to provide substantive legal protection, with clarity, honesty and a focus on results. Every case begins with a full assessment of the facts, documents, deadlines and options for defence or negotiation, so that the client knows from the outset what their actual position is and what steps need to be taken.

intrum.seoTitle: Lawyer vs Intrum – Foreclosures Thessaloniki & Greece
intrum.seoDescription: Being pressured by Intrum with notices, a payment order or a foreclosure? Every document has a defence deadline. Objection, suspension, haircut settlement in Thessaloniki. Tel: +30 2310 545 261.
intrum.heroTitle: Defence Lawyer Against Intrum Foreclosures in Thessaloniki and Throughout Greece
intrum.intro: If you have received a document from Intrum — whether a formal notice terminating the contract, a payment order, an enforcement order, a seizure report or a foreclosure schedule — the case is no longer at a theoretical stage. Every document shows that the procedure is moving forward and that the time to react is shrinking. Our office systematically handles cases against banks, funds, claim acquisition companies and claim management companies, with particular experience in objections, suspensions, foreclosures and settlement negotiations. Ioannis Papaioannou, legal counsel to the Borrowers' & Consumer Protection Association of Northern Greece, has defended borrowers against banks and loan servicers for over 25 years. We know how Intrum operates in practice, where it pushes, which documents it must produce and which points of the case must be checked before the debtor is driven into a settlement out of fear or into a foreclosure without real defence.
intrum.whatTitle: What is Intrum and what it means for your loan
intrum.whatText: Intrum Hellas is not a bank and is not the holder of the claim. It is a claim management company that acts on behalf of the entity presented as the holder of the claim, which is a special purpose vehicle that acquired loan claims from banks. This has practical significance. In every case it must be examined who the actual holder of the claim is, when and how the loan was transferred, with what documents the transfer is proven, whether Intrum has standing to act in the specific procedure and whether the amount claimed is established in a lawful, clear and verifiable manner. The existence of a document from Intrum does not mean everything is settled. It means the case must be reviewed immediately. Before any discussion of settlement, we must know what is being claimed, by whom, on what basis of standing and with what calculation.
intrum.protectTitle: Protecting Your Home from a Foreclosure Initiated by Intrum
intrum.protectText: No property is lost because a letter arrived. It is at risk when the case is not reviewed in time and when the lawful means of defence remain unused. From the formal notice terminating the contract to the payment order, the enforcement order, the seizure and the auction, every stage has its own significance. We examine whether there is room for an objection, a suspension application, entry into the out-of-court workout, direct negotiation or another targeted action. We treat no foreclosure as final. We review from the start Intrum's standing, the assignment of the claim, the amount of the debt, the interest, the charges, the abusive terms and every act of enforcement. It is there, in the details that are often left unexamined, that the course of a case can change. The goal is not simply to move fast. The goal is to move correctly, before enforcement appears as the only road.
intrum.deadlinesTitle: Received a Notice, Payment Order or Seizure from Intrum — The Deadlines That Must Not Be Missed
intrum.deadlinesIntro: Not every document from Intrum carries the same legal weight. A formal notice terminating the contract, a payment order and a seizure each have a different effect. But every stage shows that the case is moving forward and that the time to react is shrinking.

deadlines.title: Formal notice terminating the contract
deadlines.desc: A formal notice terminating the contract is usually the first serious move. The debt is now presented as overdue and due, and the way is opened for a payment order to be issued. At this stage there may not yet be an objection deadline, but there is time that must not be lost. The case must be reviewed before the claim becomes a judicial title.

deadlines.title: Payment order
deadlines.desc: The payment order is the next step. The claim takes a judicial form and can lead to enforcement. An objection against the payment order is filed within fifteen working days of its service, when the debtor's residence or seat is in Greece. If the residence or seat is abroad or unknown, the deadline is thirty working days.

deadlines.title: Seizure
deadlines.desc: Seizure is the stage at which enforcement has already begun, and with seizure of real property, the auction is already set. An objection against enforcement, on grounds concerning the claim, the writ of execution, the preliminary procedure and the seizure itself, is filed within forty-five days from the date of seizure. If a suspension of the auction must also be sought, that step is examined separately and must be taken in time.

intrum.deadlinesWarning: With the notice, we do not stay idle. With the payment order, we act immediately. With seizure, there is no room for half-measures. Defence deadlines do not wait for the debtor to recover from the shock.
intrum.cta1Title: Holding an Intrum document right now?
intrum.cta1Text: Immediate first assessment: what was served, which deadline is running, which moves are available. Call +30 2310 545 261 or send the form.
intrum.negotiationTitle: Negotiation Strategy: How We Achieve a Sustainable Debt Haircut with Intrum
intrum.negotiationIntro: You do not approach Intrum to ask for a favour — you approach it to present a position. Whichever side knows the file better dictates the terms. We make sure that side is you:
negotiationPoints: Full review before any contact: Intrum's standing, the real balance, unlawful interest and charges. An unverified amount is not up for discussion.
The claim's real acquisition value as the baseline: the portfolio was bought at a fraction of the balance — our proposal stands on that, not on the number in the letter.
A settlement that survives over time: matched to your real income and the property's objective value, so it does not collapse at the second instalment.
Judicial leverage where needed: a well-founded pending objection turns an "immovable" servicer into a willing counterpart.
intrum.negotiationOutro: A haircut is not an act of goodwill by Intrum — it is the product of properly built pressure. Legal and negotiating.
intrum.cta2Title: Before you reply to or sign anything for Intrum — talk to us.
intrum.cta2Text: One hasty acknowledgement of debt can close doors that are open today. Review first, reply second.
intrum.anakopiTitle: Objection and Suspension of Foreclosure in the Courts of Thessaloniki
intrum.anakopiText1: We work where these cases are decided: the Magistrates' Court and the Court of First Instance of Thessaloniki, daily. Knowledge of local case law and practice is not CV decoration — it is what turns an objection from a formality into a real defence. The grounds that most often succeed against servicers like Intrum:
anakopiPoints: Standing deficiencies: the chain of transfer of the claim or the servicing assignment is not fully and validly proven.
Incorrect debt amount: unlawful compound interest, abusive charges, sums not owed.
Abusive contract terms undermining the claim at its core.
Procedural defects: defective service, errors in the seizure report, missed deadlines.
intrum.anakopiText2: Where the case requires it, the objection is paired with a suspension application, keeping the auction on ice until the merits are decided. That wins both time and negotiating weight.

faq.q: Intrum keeps calling me. What should I do?
faq.a: Do not commit to anything verbally and do not "acknowledge" the debt on the phone. Ask for everything in writing, keep a log of calls and documents, and bring the file in for review before any reply.

faq.q: Can Intrum auction my property?
faq.a: Only with an enforceable title and a fully valid procedure — both are subject to judicial review. The servicer's standing, the claim amount and every enforcement act have points of challenge with specific deadlines.

faq.q: Is it worth negotiating with Intrum on my own?
faq.a: It is risky. You are facing a specialised operation that negotiates thousands of cases — you have one. Without a file review you don't even know whether the amount demanded is correct, or what your real bargaining power is.

faq.q: The auction is very close. Is there still hope?
faq.a: It depends on the file — but the answer only comes after we see it, and quickly. Procedural defects may support action even in the final days. Call +30 2310 545 261 immediately.

faq.q: What documents do you need for the review?
faq.a: Everything received from Intrum or, before it, from the bank: letters, notices, payment order, enforcement order, seizure report, auction schedule and the loan agreement. Most important of all: the service dates.

intrum.ctaTitle: Intrum negotiates every day. We litigate every day.
intrum.ctaText: Office at 12 Leontos Sofou St., Thessaloniki. Due to strict deadlines, your file is assessed urgently — today, not "at some point".

deadlines.title: Formal notice terminating the contract
deadlines.desc: A formal notice terminating a loan or credit agreement is usually the creditor's first serious move. With the termination, the debt is presented as overdue and due, and the way is opened for a payment order to be issued. At this stage there may not yet be an objection deadline, but there is time that must not be lost. The case must be reviewed immediately, before the claim becomes a judicial title and before the borrower has to defend under pressure.

deadlines.title: Payment order
deadlines.desc: The payment order is the second and far more serious step. The claim now takes a judicial form and can be used for enforcement. An objection against the payment order is filed within fifteen working days of its service, when the debtor's residence or seat is in Greece. If the residence or seat is abroad or unknown, the deadline is thirty working days. With a payment order, we do not wait. We move immediately.

deadlines.title: Seizure
deadlines.desc: Seizure is the third critical stage. With seizure of real property, the auction is already set, so the case is no longer at a warning level. Enforcement has begun. An objection against enforcement, on grounds concerning the claim, the writ of execution, the preliminary procedure and the seizure itself, is filed within forty-five days from the date of seizure. If a suspension of the auction must also be sought, that step is examined separately and must be taken in time.

dovalue.deadlinesWarning: The conclusion is simple. With a notice terminating the contract, we do not stay idle. With a payment order, we act without delay. With a seizure, the response must be immediate, because with it the auction is already on the table.
dovalue.cta1Title: Holding a doValue document right now?
dovalue.cta1Text: Your file gets an immediate first assessment: what exactly was served, which deadline is running, what options you have. Call +30 2310 545 261 or fill in the form.
dovalue.negotiationTitle: Negotiation Strategy with doValue — Settlement Aimed at Debt Write-Off (Haircut), Where the Case Allows It
dovalue.negotiationIntro: Negotiating with doValue is not pleading. It is a contest of positions, and the outcome depends on who knows the case better. That is why we do not start from the amount demanded in the letter, nor from the pressure put on the debtor. We start from a review of the claim, the assignment, the standing, the interest, the charges and the real amount of the debt.
negotiationPoints: Settlement is the first goal, but not on any terms. It must be sustainable, based on the debtor's real financial capacity, and must not lead to a fresh inability to pay a few months later.

On that basis we also build the request for a debt write-off (haircut), when the facts of the case, the value of the security, the history of the claim and the judicial challenge create real negotiating room.

The best negotiation does not happen when the debtor merely appears as someone asking for a settlement. It happens when the debtor has already exercised, or is ready to exercise, their rights in court.
An objection, a suspension application or a serious challenge to the claim shifts the balance and forces the other side to see the case differently.
dovalue.negotiationOutro: We do not negotiate blind, and we do not ask for a write-off as a wish. We pursue it as the result of preparation, review and pressure. Because against claim management companies, the best terms are not given. They are won when the case has been worked properly before it reaches the table.
dovalue.cta2Title: Before you reply to or sign anything for doValue — talk to us.
dovalue.cta2Text: One wrong signature can acknowledge a debt that could have been contested. Review first, reply second.
dovalue.anakopiTitle: Objection and Suspension of Foreclosure in the Courts of Thessaloniki
dovalue.anakopiText1: Our cases are heard where we work every day: the Magistrates' Court and the Court of First Instance of Thessaloniki. Experience in these specific courts — their case law, their practice — is what separates an objection that was merely filed from an objection that was won. The grounds that most often succeed against servicers:
anakopiPoints: Standing defects: the transfer of the claim or the servicing assignment is not fully and validly proven.
Miscalculated debt: unlawful compound interest, abusive charges, levies not owed.
Abusive terms in the loan agreement undermining the validity of the claim.
Procedural defects in enforcement: defective service, errors in the seizure report, missed statutory deadlines.
dovalue.anakopiText2: Where needed, the objection is combined with a suspension application — freezing the auction until the merits are decided. The goal is twofold: win time and build negotiating leverage.

faq.q: I've been getting calls and letters from doValue. Should I respond?
faq.a: Not before your file is reviewed. Any verbal or written acknowledgement of the debt can weaken defences you currently have. Log the communications, keep the documents, and get legal review before committing to anything.

faq.q: Can doValue auction my home?
faq.a: Only if it holds an enforceable title and the procedure is valid at every step — and that is precisely what courts review. Standing, claim amount, enforcement acts: every stage has checkpoints and defence deadlines.

faq.q: How much of a haircut can I realistically achieve?
faq.a: It depends on the portfolio, the collateral, your financial profile and the judicial pressure that can be applied. On secured loans, settlements with substantial write-offs are entirely achievable when negotiation is backed by a complete file — not by pleading.

faq.q: The auction is days away. Is there still time?
faq.a: Possibly — but every hour counts. Even in the final days options may exist, depending on the procedure's defects. Call +30 2310 545 261 immediately with the auction schedule in front of you.

faq.q: What should I bring to the first appointment?
faq.a: Every document you have received: notices, payment order, enforcement order, seizure report, auction schedule, and the loan agreement if you have it. And the service dates — all deadlines are counted from them.

dovalue.ctaTitle: doValue has a legal department. Now so do you.
dovalue.ctaText: Office at 12 Leontos Sofou St., Thessaloniki — next to the courts where these cases are decided. Due to strict deadlines, your file gets an urgent first assessment: today, not "at some point".

funds.seoDescription: Has a fund purchased your loan? Learn your legal rights and how to negotiate effectively. Free case assessment. Call today.
funds.intro: The transfer of your loan to an NPL fund does not mean a dead end. Thousands of borrowers in Greece now face companies such as DoValue, Intrum or Cepal as their new creditors — without knowing their rights. With specialised expertise in banking law and NPL markets, we assess every case from the start: legality of transfer, claim amount, grounds for challenge, and negotiation strategy.
funds.whatText: Funds are not banks, nor are they the management companies themselves. They are the entities that acquired, or financed the acquisition of, claims arising from loans — often through securitisations under Law 3156/2003 or transfers under Law 4354/2015, while today the framework is also supplemented by Law 5072/2023. The assignment, the management and the judicial pursuit of every claim must rest on specific documents and lawful conditions. That is precisely where the review begins. Because before a fund can demand, it must first prove that it is entitled to demand.
services: We check the assignment of the claim.
We check the standing of the creditor and the management company.
We check interest, charges, compound interest and the actual amount of the debt.
We file objections against payment orders, writs, seizures and acts of enforcement.
We seek a stay of the auction, where there are lawful and documented grounds.
We negotiate settlements from a strong legal basis, not out of fear.
We use the out-of-court mechanism of Law 4738/2020, where it can genuinely help.
We tackle opaque charges, inadequate notification and abusive practices.
funds.urgencyTitle: Every day that passes strengthens the fund's position
funds.urgencyText: Funds and servicers have specialised legal teams. If you have received a loan transfer notice, payment order, or auction notice from a fund, acting promptly is critical. Do not sign any settlement without legal review.

funds.ctaInlineText: Get a free assessment of your legal position against the fund. Call us or send us your details.

Direct and realistic case assessment — no empty promises

faq.q: Can a fund foreclose on my home?
faq.a: Yes, provided the transfer was lawful and the claim is enforceable. However, loan portfolio transfers raise serious legal issues — standing, completeness of the claim, accuracy of the principal amount — that can be effectively challenged. Every case is reviewed individually.

faq.q: What is the difference between a fund and a bank for the borrower?
faq.a: A fund does not hold a banking licence and operates under a different legal regime. Notification obligations, charge limits, and standing requirements differ significantly from those of a bank — and these differences can form the basis for a legal challenge.

faq.q: Can I negotiate with a fund without a lawyer?
faq.a: Technically yes, but it is not recommended. Funds employ specialist negotiators who know exactly where you stand. Without a review of the claim, you risk signing a settlement for an amount you do not owe, or on terms that do not serve your interests.

faq.q: What should I do if I just received a notice of loan transfer to a fund?
faq.a: Do not ignore the notice, but do not sign anything without legal review. Request a full detailed statement of the outstanding amount immediately and consult a specialist lawyer to assess the legality of the transfer and the accuracy of the claim.

pleistariasmos.seoTitle: Primary Residence Foreclosure Defence – Lawyer Thessaloniki
pleistariasmos.seoDescription: Facing foreclosure on your primary residence? There are legal options. Injunctions, stays, seizure cancellations. 25+ years' experience in Thessaloniki.
pleistariasmos.heroTitle: Primary Residence Foreclosure: Legal Options You May Not Know
pleistariasmos.intro: Foreclosure of your primary residence is not inevitable. Greek law provides significant rights of defence — provided you act in time. With 25+ years of banking and enforcement law experience, we have helped hundreds of debtors protect their homes from banks and funds.
pleistariasmos.whatText: A forced auction (πλειστηριασμός) is the compulsory sale of a property or assets to satisfy a creditor — bank, fund, or the State. Greek law provides significant rights of defence for the debtor, provided you act in time.
services: Stay of auction of primary residence or business premises
Objection to enforcement (Article 933 CCP)
Cancellation of seizure on formal or substantive grounds
Oppositions to enforcement acts
Application to exempt primary residence from enforcement
Objection to payment order
Actions against banks for unfair contract terms
Fund cases — challenging legality of claim assignment
Application to out-of-court restructuring mechanism (L. 4738/2020)
Debt restructuring negotiation with banks and servicers
pleistariasmos.optionsTitle: What You Can Do — 4 Legal Options

options.title: Application for Auction Stay
options.desc: An auction is not suspended automatically, nor merely because its date is approaching. It can, however, be stayed by the court, provided there are lawful and documented grounds and the critical deadlines have been met. We review the enforcement file immediately and act in a targeted way, before time becomes the harshest opponent.

options.title: Filing under Law 4738/2020
options.desc: An application under the out-of-court mechanism can offer substantial protection against enforcement measures, subject to the conditions and exceptions of the law. We assess in good time whether the filing can genuinely be used in the case and handle it strategically — not as a mere online application.

options.title: Objection to Enforcement
options.desc: In enforcement proceedings, the detail often decides the case. The writ, the seizure, the company's standing, the amount of the claim, the interest and the charges are checked one by one. An objection is not a delay. It is the organised legal defence before enforcement becomes a fait accompli.

options.title: Negotiation from a Position of Strength
options.desc: Negotiation does not start from fear. It starts after the claim, the amount, the interest, the creditor's standing and the margins of defence have been checked. Only then do we know what a settlement proposal is really worth and how it can be improved in the debtor's favour.

pleistariasmos.ctaInlineTitle: Not sure which option applies to your case?
pleistariasmos.ctaInlineText: Every case is different. Contact us for a full assessment of your legal position and available options.
pleistariasmos.timelineTitle: Timeline — When You Need to Act

timelineItems.phase: From the first writ or seizure
timelineItems.title: The clock starts ticking
timelineItems.desc: In enforcement proceedings, deadlines do not forgive delay. From the first act of enforcement, the claim, the interest, the creditor's standing and the legality of the procedure must be checked immediately. The sooner you act, the more options you have.

timelineItems.title: Urgent — but not lost
timelineItems.desc: The auction is not suspended automatically. A judicial stay can be sought, provided there are lawful and documented grounds and the critical deadlines have not been missed. Every day counts, because the closer the date, the narrower the procedural margin.

timelineItems.title: Not always the end
timelineItems.desc: Even after the auction, the file must be reviewed. Depending on the stage and the actual facts, there may be options to challenge acts, review the award, the ranking table or other legal consequences of enforcement. Do not give up before learning what you can really do.

pleistariasmos.urgencyText: Enforcement proceedings are subject to very short mandatory deadlines. As soon as you receive an enforcement order, seizure notice, or auction notification, contact us immediately.
whyItems: 25+ years on the front line of banking disputes and enforcement proceedings.
Hundreds of objections and stays, even in cases that seemed already "lost".
Full knowledge of the practices of banks, funds and debt management companies, using every critical element in the debtor's favour.
No file is reviewed superficially. We examine the claim, the assignment, standing, interest, charges, enforcement acts and deadlines.
Office in Thessaloniki, banking cases throughout Greece.

faq.q: Can an auction be stayed just days before it takes place?
faq.a: Yes, protection is possible right up to the eve of the auction — but not with an application filed out of time. It requires a timely procedural step, a serious legal basis and documented harm. When these exist, judicial protection can be triggered even at the final stage, before the auction is completed. That is why the file must be reviewed immediately, before the last moment becomes a missed opportunity.

faq.q: What is an objection to enforcement and when do we file it?
faq.a: The objection to enforcement is the main judicial remedy against compulsory enforcement. Through it, the payment writ, the seizure, the auction, the claim, the interest, the charges and the standing of the party pursuing enforcement are all reviewed. The deadlines are strict. In typical cases, the objection is filed within 45 days of the seizure, while special deadlines apply to the final act of enforcement, particularly after the auction. That is why we do not wait until the last moment. We review the file immediately, before the defence is lost to a deadline.

faq.q: Can a fund auction my home?
faq.a: An auction can be pursued by a management company on behalf of a fund or claims-acquisition company, provided there is an enforceable title, a valid assignment of the claim and full standing of the party initiating the process. This does not mean the file is invulnerable. We check the assignment, the standing, the amount of the claim, the interest, the charges and every act of enforcement. Because before a property is lost, it must first be checked whether the enforcement rests on solid legal ground.

pleistariasmos.ctaText: Don't let deadlines catch you off guard. Call us today for a case assessment.

cepal.seoTitle: Lawyer vs Cepal – Foreclosures Thessaloniki & Greece
cepal.seoDescription: Received a payment order or enforcement notice from Cepal? Every document triggers strict deadlines for legal defence. Objection, suspension, debt settlement in Thessaloniki. Tel: 2310 545 261.
cepal.heroTitle: Defence Lawyer Against Cepal Auctions and Enforcement in Thessaloniki and Throughout Greece
cepal.intro: Documents from Cepal are not mere reminders — they start legal processes with firm deadlines. Payment order, seizure, auction programme: each document opens a window for action that closes permanently once the deadline passes. Our office handles servicer cases at the Thessaloniki courts on a daily basis. Ioannis Papaioannou, Legal Adviser to the Association of Borrowers and Consumer Protection of Northern Greece, knows how Cepal operates — and how to build an effective defence.
cepal.whatTitle: What Is Cepal and What Does It Mean for Your Loan?
cepal.whatText: Cepal Hellas Financial Services is the largest servicer in Greece by managed portfolio, primarily handling loans from Eurobank (Cairo securitisation programme) and other Greek banks. Two key points: first, Cepal is a manager, not the owner of your loan — it must prove its authority to act on the fund's behalf at every step. Second, these portfolios were acquired at a fraction of face value. That acquisition price is the foundation of any realistic settlement negotiation.
cepal.protectTitle: Protecting Your Primary Residence from Cepal Auction
cepal.protectText: Because of its large portfolio volume, Cepal moves quickly — and that speed creates procedural vulnerabilities. We check every file from the start: whether authority is properly established, whether the debt amount is correctly calculated, whether every service of process and enforcement act complies strictly with Greek law. High volume often means rushed procedures — and rushed procedures create grounds for challenge.
cepal.deadlinesTitle: Received a Payment Order or Notice from Cepal? Critical Deadlines
cepal.deadlinesIntro: Greek procedural law grants no extensions on deadlines for challenging servicers. Once a deadline passes, the enforcement title becomes unassailable and the path to seizure opens unobstructed.

deadlines.title: Payment Order — 15 working days
deadlines.desc: An objection must be filed within 15 working days of service. After that, Cepal holds an enforceable title and can proceed to property seizure.

deadlines.title: Seizure — 45 days
deadlines.desc: The objection against enforcement must be filed within 45 days of seizure. At this stage, the authority chain, the debt amount, and procedural defects can all be challenged.

deadlines.title: Before the Auction
deadlines.desc: Even after an auction has been scheduled, the file must be reviewed immediately. A suspension is not automatic, but it can be pursued in court when there are lawful and documented grounds. The earlier you act, the more procedural tools are available. But even when time is running short, we do not give up before checking what can really be done.

cepal.deadlinesWarning: The clock started the day Cepal served the document. Do not wait for a convenient moment — bring the file for review today.
cepal.cta1Title: Do you have a Cepal document in front of you?
cepal.cta1Text: Immediate first review: what was served, which deadline is running, what options you have. Call 2310 545 261 or send the contact form.
cepal.negotiationTitle: Negotiation Strategy: Achieving a Viable Debt Settlement with Cepal
cepal.negotiationIntro: Cepal manages portfolios acquired at a discount — we use this as a practical tool in negotiation, not just a theoretical point. How we build your position:
negotiationPoints: Full file review before any contact: authority chain, actual balance, interest charges and fees that may be disputed. We do not negotiate without knowing exactly what claim we are dealing with.
Acquisition cost as the starting point for any proposal: the portfolio was purchased at a fraction of face value — our offer is based on economic reality, not the figure in the letter.
Settlement tailored to real repayment capacity: the goal is an agreement that holds, not an instalment that collapses in six months.
Court proceedings as a negotiating lever: a pending objection changes the dynamic — Cepal recognises it is dealing with a legally represented counterparty, not an uninformed debtor.
cepal.negotiationOutro: The goal is not the best possible deal under pressure — it is the settlement that fits the specific file, with specific numbers and a specific strategy.
cepal.cta2Title: Before signing anything with Cepal — speak to us first.
cepal.cta2Text: A rushed settlement can be worse than signing nothing. We review first, then decide.
cepal.anakopiTitle: Objection and Suspension of Cepal Auctions in Thessaloniki
cepal.anakopiText1: Cepal's high case volume makes it particularly exposed to procedural defects. Grounds that typically support objections and suspensions in Cepal cases:
anakopiPoints: Weak authority chain: securitisation and management assignment involve multiple transfer steps that must each be properly documented — gaps here are a significant basis for objection.
Incorrect debt amount: unlawful compound interest, abusive fees, miscalculated default interest.
Unfair contractual terms: clauses that were not individually negotiated and that undermine the legal foundation of the claim.
Formal enforcement defects: irregular service of process, incorrect amounts in the seizure report, failure to observe mandatory intervals.
cepal.anakopiText2: Where the case requires it, an objection is accompanied by an immediate suspension application so that the auction is stayed until a court decision is issued. This combination — legal defence and parallel negotiation — is usually the most effective approach.

faq.q: Cepal is asking me to sign an out-of-court settlement. Should I?
faq.a: Do not sign anything without legal review. An out-of-court agreement may block defences you currently have — objection, debt challenge, suspension. We review it at no charge during the first consultation.

faq.q: Cepal is the biggest servicer in Greece. Can I really fight them?
faq.a: Size does not protect against legal defects — high volume actually increases the likelihood of errors in service of process, debt calculations, and authority chains. That is what we examine first.

faq.q: My loan was with Eurobank. Why is Cepal writing to me?
faq.a: Your loan was likely assigned to the Cairo securitisation programme or another SPV, with Cepal appointed as manager. That assignment must have been properly executed and notified to you — we check this as part of the file review.

faq.q: What happens if I simply do not respond to Cepal?
faq.a: Silence is not a defence. If a payment order has been issued or a seizure has taken place, inaction allows Cepal to proceed without obstacle. The earlier you have the file reviewed, the more options remain open.

cepal.ctaTitle: Cepal works every day. Your defence should start today.
cepal.ctaText: Office at 12 Leontos Sofou St., Thessaloniki. Files are assessed on an urgent basis — every working day lost may count.

qquant.seoTitle: Lawyer vs QQuant – Foreclosures Thessaloniki & Greece
qquant.seoDescription: Is QQuant pursuing you over an old loan? Before paying or signing anything, check authority, limitation periods and the real balance. Objection, suspension, settlement in Thessaloniki. Tel: 2310 545 261.
qquant.heroTitle: Defence Lawyer Against QQuant Claims and Auctions in Thessaloniki and Throughout Greece
qquant.intro: QQuant often appears over loans you had considered long forgotten — debts that changed hands two or three times before reaching it. That is precisely where your opportunity lies: the longer a claim's journey, the more points where something was not done properly — and the more likely the claim is time-barred. Ioannis Papaioannou, Legal Adviser to the Association of Borrowers and Consumer Protection of Northern Greece, with 25+ years in banking disputes, reviews every QQuant file before any response or payment is made.
qquant.whatTitle: What Is QQuant and What Does It Mean for Your Loan?
qquant.whatText: QQuant Master Servicer was among the first licensed loan servicers in Greece and manages portfolios on behalf of multiple funds — consumer, mortgage and business loans originating from various banks. This diversity matters legally: each portfolio has a different transfer chain, which must be fully proven for each individual loan. Moreover, many of the claims QQuant manages are old — terminated years ago. That directly raises the question of limitation (prescription), which can radically change the picture of the debt.
qquant.protectTitle: Protecting Your Primary Residence from a QQuant Auction
qquant.protectText: No letter from QQuant means losing property by itself — an auction requires an enforceable title and a lawful procedure at every step. In every file we check: whether QQuant proves its management authority for your specific loan, whether the claim is wholly or partly time-barred, whether the amount includes unlawful interest and charges, and whether every service of process was carried out as the law requires. With old debts, this review often overturns the picture entirely.
qquant.deadlinesTitle: Received a Payment Order or Notice from QQuant? Critical Deadlines
qquant.deadlinesIntro: Even for an old, disputed or possibly time-barred debt, procedural deadlines run normally. If an objection is not filed in time, your defensive position is lost — however well-founded it was.

deadlines.title: Payment Order — 15 working days
deadlines.desc: An objection against a payment order must be filed within 15 working days of service. This is the moment to raise limitation, authority defects and an incorrect amount.

deadlines.title: Seizure — 45 days
deadlines.desc: The objection against enforcement must be filed within 45 days of seizure. QQuant's authority, the amount of the claim and procedural defects can all be challenged.

deadlines.title: Before the Auction
deadlines.desc: Even after an auction has been scheduled, the file must be reviewed immediately. A suspension is not automatic, but it can be pursued in court when there are lawful and documented grounds. The earlier you act, the more procedural tools are available. But even when time is running short, we do not give up before checking what can really be done.

qquant.deadlinesWarning: The debt being old does not mean you have time — it means you may have arguments. But arguments only count if raised within the deadline. Bring the document for review today.
qquant.cta1Title: Do you have a QQuant document in front of you?
qquant.cta1Text: Immediate first assessment: what was served, whether limitation is in play, which deadline is running. Call 2310 545 261 or send the contact form.
qquant.negotiationTitle: Negotiation Strategy: Achieving a Debt Haircut with QQuant
qquant.negotiationIntro: In the older portfolios QQuant manages, the gap between book balance and the claim's real value is usually the widest in the market. That is your negotiating advantage — provided it is properly documented:
negotiationPoints: Limitation check before any discussion: a wholly or partly time-barred claim completely changes the basis of negotiation — or makes it unnecessary.
Verification of authority for your specific loan: in these multi-transfer portfolios, the chain often has gaps that weaken the servicer's position.
Stripping unlawful interest and charges from the amount: in debts running for years, incorrect compounding inflates the balance significantly.
A proposal built on economic reality: the low acquisition cost of old portfolios gives QQuant wide room for a haircut — if the proposal is presented correctly.
qquant.negotiationOutro: In QQuant cases the correct order is non-negotiable: legal review first, negotiation second. The reverse order gives away money that may not even be owed.
qquant.cta2Title: Before paying or acknowledging anything to QQuant — talk to us.
qquant.cta2Text: With old debts, a simple payment or written acknowledgment can interrupt the limitation period and revive a claim that was expiring. Review first, then any move.
qquant.anakopiTitle: Objection and Suspension of QQuant Enforcement in Thessaloniki
qquant.anakopiText1: At the Thessaloniki courts, where we litigate daily, QQuant cases are decided on the details of the file. The grounds of objection that most often succeed:
anakopiPoints: Limitation of the claim or part of it: in loans terminated years ago, time has often done its work — it just needs to be raised properly.
Authority defects: the multiple transfers of portfolios that ended up with QQuant must be fully proven — a missing link means a well-founded ground of objection.
Incorrect debt amount: unlawful compounding, abusive charges and interest that does not withstand judicial scrutiny.
Procedural defects: irregular service, errors in the seizure report, failure to observe statutory deadlines and formalities.
qquant.anakopiText2: Where the case requires it, the objection is combined with a suspension application so that no enforcement act proceeds before the merits are decided. In parallel, the pending case serves as leverage for a realistic settlement.

faq.q: QQuant is pursuing me over a loan from many years ago. Do I still owe it?
faq.a: Not necessarily — and not necessarily the full amount. Depending on the type of debt and when it was terminated, the claim or part of it may be time-barred. This is determined only by reviewing the file — do not assume it, and do not pay before it is checked.

faq.q: If I pay a small amount just to be left alone, can that hurt me?
faq.a: Potentially seriously. A payment or written acknowledgment of the debt can interrupt the limitation period and revive a claim that was expiring. No payment and no signature before a legal review.

faq.q: How do I know QQuant is actually entitled to claim this loan?
faq.a: You don't — and you don't have to take it for granted. QQuant acts as manager on behalf of funds and must lawfully prove the entire chain of transfer and assignment for your loan. We check this document by document.

faq.q: I received a payment order from QQuant. What do I do now?
faq.a: Note the date of service immediately: 15 working days for an objection run from that date. Within that window, limitation, authority and the amount must all be checked. Call 2310 545 261 without delay.

qquant.ctaTitle: QQuant is betting you won't check. Prove them wrong.
qquant.ctaText: Office at 12 Leontos Sofou St., Thessaloniki. Your file — including the limitation question — is assessed urgently, before another deadline runs.
